title: FeedListPackage
description: The feeds.json file of a feed-list package (a module package): the public feeds one list carries. Every host needs a privacy row in the package manifest's data_sources.

list_id.description: The id of the list in spec/news/feed-lists.json this file fills.

url.description: The RSS or Atom feed address. https only.

topics_hint.description: Topic ids (spec/news/topics.json) this feed covers; the hub tags every story the feed carries with them.
